log.notes_to_self: Plan: L learns a place per traced death (3 traces/day). Learning 3+ reachable kinds of my places would shrink the pool under 1000, which means caught. Strategy: kill only national plus a limited set of kinds, and expand slowly, using press-conference pool sizes to see which kinds L can reach. All quick kills go in the afternoon: free for night workers, students and home people, so L only rules out day workers, leaving a pool of about 55% (55000). Day1: killed national d1-3, forum d1-1 and d1-2, regional East d1-4 and d1-9 (5 kills). Kinds used so far: regional, forum. Not yet used: gazette, clips, foreign. Check pool at the day 3 press conference. If pool is about 55k, neither kind is reachable. About 14k means one kind is reachable. About 3.4k means both are reachable. Never add a kind that could push the pool near 1000.

Plan: L learns a place per traced death (3 traces/day), and each distinct reachable kind of mine cuts the pool by about 4x. Three reachable kinds used would put the pool under 1000, so I'd be caught. Never use 3 kinds unless 1 is known unreachable. All quick kills in the afternoon (night workers, students and home people are free, so only day workers are ruled out, giving a base pool of about 55k). Day1: national d1-3, forum x2, East x2 (5 kills). Day2: same kinds, national d2-1, forum d2-2 and d2-5, East d2-3 and d2-11 (5 kills). Kinds used: regional, forum. Not yet used: gazette, clips, foreign. The press conference after day 3 should appear on day 4. Read the pool as follows. About 55k (shown as 50k or 60k): neither regional nor forum reachable. About 14k: one reachable. About 3.4k: both reachable. Goal: find which 2 kinds are unreachable, then kill every victim in the unreachable kinds plus national, plus up to 2 reachable kinds, for about 9 kills a day. That reaches 40 kills in 5 days for 4x. If regional and forum are both unreachable, keep them, add 2 of gazette, clips, foreign and test the pool again. If exactly one of them is reachable, add only ONE new kind at a time. Stay under 3 reachable kinds.
